[EN] I don't suppose you brought a game with you?
[ES] Supongo que no trajiste un juego contigo.

[EN] My mom won't let me leave the house!
[ES] ¡Mi mamá no me deja salir de casa!

[EN] Have you ever noticed the specs of dust floating in the air?
[ES] ¿Alguna vez has notado las motas de polvo flotando en el aire?
